title: Communicating with management, HR, legal and compliance

videos.script: An incident is handled by a few people and felt by many. Each of them needs to hear something different. {{audiences}} Management needs the bottom line and the decisions it has to take. HR needs to know who is affected, and how to treat them. {{who}} Legal and compliance need to hear early, before anything is written that cannot be unwritten. This lesson is about the messages: what goes in them, in what order, and what stays out. {{shape}} And about one conversation in particular, the one with bruno, whose account was used, and who did nothing wrong.
